zh-CN.title: Monifa 验证码分享卡片
items: Monifa 分享链接支持验证码卡片，可复制、查看有效时间并手动刷新
过期验证码自动隐藏，分享撤销或网络异常时展示明确状态

en.title: Monifa shared code cards
items: Monifa share links display codes with copy, expiry and manual refresh controls
Expired codes are hidden, with clear states for revoked shares and network errors
